title: Extended Bloch group and the Cheeger-Chern-Simons class
note: PDF library/0307092v2/ — Geom. Topol. 8 (2004), 413-474, DOI 10.2140/gt.2004.8.413, arXiv:math/0307092. Sections 1 and 14 associate to every complete finite-volume hyperbolic 3-manifold M a canonical fundamental class in H_3(PSL(2,C); Z) ~= B-hat(C) whose Rogers-dilogarithm / Cheeger-Chern-Simons evaluation yields i(Vol(M) + i CS(M)) (bean qou-bagd).
